rules.title: Boursa Kuwait public market data delay notice
rules.verified_claim: The public market watch/trading data is displayed with a 15-minute delay.
rules.operational_effect: Public pages cannot establish live execution capability; completed-session evidence still requires saved bytes and reconciliation.

rules.title: Trading Information
rules.verified_claim: The official page publishes the current opening auction, continuous trading, closing auction, and Trade-at-Last session times and describes broker live data versus the delayed website.
rules.operational_effect: Session times belong to an effective-dated session regime and must not be hard-coded across history without evidence.

rules.title: NMS and Circuit Breakers
rules.verified_claim: The official page states security-level upper and lower price limits of +10% and -5% and describes the associated auction mechanism.
rules.operational_effect: Upper-limit detection is censored for execution until fill/queue evidence exists; lower-limit states are not normal executable quotes.

rules.title: Data Vendors
rules.verified_claim: Boursa Kuwait publishes information on approved data vendors that may provide real-time, delayed, historical, and analytical data services.
rules.operational_effect: A licensed vendor is the logical path for execution-grade data, but a project entitlement must still be configured and evidenced.

rules.title: Mandatory use of the electronic disclosure system based on XBRL
rules.verified_claim: The CMA release describes mandatory electronic disclosure through the XBRL-based iFSAH system beginning 5 January 2025 for the covered entities and disclosures.
rules.operational_effect: iFSAH is a primary structured disclosure source; collectors must preserve publication timestamps, attachments, corrections, and transition-channel completeness.
